description: This Java class defines a rule engine node for deleting key-value pairs from message data or metadata within the Thingsboard platform. It includes configuration, initialization, and message processing logic for key deletion based on patterns.

classes.name: TbDeleteKeysNode
classes.description: A rule node for deleting specified key-value pairs from message data or metadata based on configured patterns.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, setting the source of deletion and compiling key patterns.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages to delete keys from metadata or data according to patterns.

methods.name: getNewKeyForUpgradeFromVersionZero
methods.description: Returns the key name used for upgrade from version zero.

methods.name: getKeyToUpgradeFromVersionOne
methods.description: Returns the key name used for upgrade from version one.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given key matches any of the compiled patterns.
